description.value:
You can use your Channel Divinity to inflict your enemies with a deep, biting cold that cripples their ability to fight or cast spells.

As an Action, you present your holy symbol and choose a number of creatures up to equal to your Proficiency you can see within 30 feet of you. Each affected creature has to make a CON Saving Throw. Any creature affected by your Winter's Touch class feature has Disadvantage on this Saving Throw.

On a failure, their movement Speed is halved and they have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls for 1 minute. If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action, roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the creature completes the spell as normal. On a 10 or lower, the spell is lost. At the end of their turn, they can repeat the Saving Throw, ending the effect on a success.

This feature has no effect on creatures that are Immune to cold damage.
